channel.title: Wire — Rust
channel.description: Rust from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Flagged by the Machine: How Google Ads Suspended an Open-Source macOS Term as Malicious
item.description: Przemyslaw Alexander Kaminski created RACE, a Rust terminal multiplexer on an infinite canvas that detaches child shells into background processes. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Async Rust: Where does the scheduler live?
item.description: It turns out that some issues people have with async Rust are just downstream of hard concurrency problems. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Aspire 13.6 Adds Persistent Dashboard Telemetry and First-Party Java and Rust Hosting
item.description: Microsoft has released Aspire 13.6. The dashboard now stores telemetry in SQLite and keeps up to ten completed runs per application. (1 source: infoq)
